email_business_rules.title: Source Journal Entry Data from Email
email_business_rules.description: Extract journal entry. Filters: document_name = active document source_type = Email. Output: journal entry records for accrual processing.

email_business_rules.title: Validate Company Code Is 1000
email_business_rules.description: Validate journal entry records: Check Company Code = 1000 against each journal entry in the Email-based journal submission system. Any journal entry with a Company Code other than 1000 is treated as invalid for processing. Output: validated company code records.
email_business_rules.context: description:journal entries with valid company code 1000}

email_business_rules.title: Validate Document Type Is SA
email_business_rules.description: Validate journal entry records: Check Document Type = SA against each journal entry in the Email-based journal submission system. Any journal entry with a Document Type other than SA is treated as invalid for processing. Output: validated document type records.
email_business_rules.context: description:journal entries with valid document type SA}

email_business_rules.title: Validate GL Account Excludes 1000 and 3000 Series
email_business_rules.description: Validate journal entry records: Check GL Account does NOT LIKE 1000% AND GL Account does NOT LIKE 3000% on each journal entry in the Email-based journal submission system. GL Account series 1000 (Asset accounts) and 3000 (Equity accounts) must not appear in Accrual Journals. Output: validated GL account records.
email_business_rules.document_version: description:journal entries with valid GL accounts excluding 1000 and 3000 series}

email_business_rules.title: Validate Cost Center on 6100 Series Expense Lines
email_business_rules.description: Validate journal entry records: Check that where GL Account LIKE 6100%
email_business_rules.document_created_at: description:expense lines with valid cost center assignments for 6100 series GL accounts}

email_business_rules.title: Validate Debit Credit Balance at Batch Level
email_business_rules.description: Validate journal entry batch records: Check sum(Debit amounts) = sum(Credit amounts) across all lines within each batch in the Email-based journal submission system. Total debits must equal total credits at batch level; any imbalance prevents further processing. Output: validated balanced batch records.
email_business_rules.context: description:journal entry batches with balanced debit and credit totals}

email_business_rules.title: Calculate Monthly Journal Amount from Annual
email_business_rules.description: Calculate monthly journal amount on journal entry records. Formula: total annual posting amount / 12. Output: journal entries with calculated monthly amounts.
email_business_rules.context: description:journal entries with monthly amounts derived from annual posting amounts}
